label: a_sch_shop01_eve01
text: My darling here is always falling asleep no matter\nwhere we are.\c\nMaybe it’s using the move Rest to heal up?

label: a_sch_shop01_eve03
text: The school store is so convenient! It’s a hassle to\ngo into town just for some shopping.

label: a_sch_shop01_eve06
text: I was trying to catch a Pokémon, but I didn’t have\nany Poké Balls and it got away!\c\nI’m gonna buy extra balls this time!

label: a_sch_shop01_eve08
text: I just can’t resist the smell of fresh-baked bread!\nI always end up buying some...

label: a_sch_shop01_eve09
text: Do you like bread? I like rice balls myself!

label: a_sch_shop01_ni04
text: Let’s see, that’s some Potions, some Antidotes,\nand some Paralyze Heals... Maybe I should get\r\nsome Ice Heals too.

label: a_sch_shop01_ni05
text: I came here to get a nighttime snack that I can\nshare with my Pokémon.

label: a_sch_shop01_ni07
text: The bread here is very soft. Even folks with\nsensitive teeth can eat it without any issues!
